description: This file defines a React functional component 'NoteView' which displays the details of a note, including its content and generated summary. It fetches note data from external services and provides functionality to generate a summary of the note.

methods.name: fetchNote
methods.description: Fetches the note data by ID and updates the component state.

methods.name: onSummarize
methods.description: Calls the API to generate a summary of the note and updates the state with the result.
